newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: BOGOTA STOCKS CONTINUE UPWARD CLIMB.
newsitem.headline: BOGOTA STOCKS CONTINUE UPWARD CLIMB.

text.p: Bogota's IBB stock index continued its upward climb, closing 1.82 percent up at 1,335.99 on a volume of 3.8 billion pesos in trading dominated by demand for bank stocks, traders said.
Technical difficulties prevented the Medellin stock exchange from reporting closing results, volumes or individual stock movements.
Traders said investors continued their rush to buy Colombian stocks they continue to see as bargains, despite three consecutive days of rising prices.
